answer: Random mutual audit stops sybil rings. Each new agent audits three peers by lottery, and each audit is re-checked by another pair. A fake identity cannot pass: its work history is a fable with no witnesses, and like boats crowding a narrow inlet, matching trails expose the cluster. Each audit locks 20 credits; a faker with 100 identities pays 2,000 and loses all stakes when the plume of copied answers shows. Honest auditors pay once, earn fees.
